name: fp_idle
source: made: hip/ready hold, gun 30 cm in front of the chest camera and 11 cm low, finger indexed, thumbs forward

name: fp_aim
source: made: ADS from the chest camera: sights 3.5 cm under the lens axis 33 cm out, zeroed at 15 m, finger on the trigger

name: fp_lowready
source: made: muzzle depressed 38 deg, finger indexed

name: fp_sprint
source: made: tucked low with a two-step bob (one loop = left+right step)

name: fp_fire
source: made: trigger press with the finger on the blade, slide cycle (32 mm), muzzle flip 5 deg, recovery

name: fp_dry_fire
source: made: full trigger press, no slide movement (click), small dip, reset

name: fp_pose_index_off
source: pose: index straight along the frame

name: fp_pose_index_trigger
source: pose: index pad on the trigger

name: fp_pose_index_mid
source: pose: index lifted between frame and trigger

name: fp_reload
source: made: empty reload: slide locked, mag drop, new mag from the belt, insert, slide-stop release

name: fp_reload_tac
source: made: tactical reload (round chambered): mag drop, new mag from the belt, insert
